editorialIntro.heading: Are Shore Excursions Included on Oceania Cruises?
paragraphs: Oceania Cruises offers a large collection of shore excursions, but not every tour is automatically included in the cruise fare. Guests can purchase individual excursions, choose from specialty tour collections, arrange private experiences or explore independently.

Eligible bookings may also receive a shore excursion credit through Oceania's Your World Included program. The credit is an optional booking amenity where guests choose between the shore excursion credit and Complimentary Wine and Beer, subject to applicable booking terms. The credit amount ranges from $400 to $1,200 depending on the length of the voyage.

Oceania's excursion portfolio includes cultural tours, historical sightseeing, chef-led culinary experiences, small-group excursions, wellness activities, private tours and immersive local community encounters.

tourCollections.title: Types of Oceania Cruises Shore Excursions
intro: Oceania categorizes its shore excursions into distinct thematic collections designed for different travel styles.
From architectural walks and food market shopping to private driver arrangements and small-group outings, discover the 10 tour collections available fleet-wide.

items.title: 1. Beyond Blueprints Tours – Architecture & Design
paragraphs: Beyond Blueprints tours offer in-depth architectural and engineering perspectives on world-famous structures and modern design marvels.
Rather than standard surface sightseeing, guests receive behind-the-scenes access, architectural commentary, and context on how urban landscapes evolved.
Best for: Architecture aficionados, design enthusiasts, and travelers fascinated by structural engineering and history.

lists.title: Example Beyond Blueprints Highlights
items: Exclusive architectural tours of Gaudí masterworks in Barcelona
Behind-the-scenes visits to the Royal Library and modern harbor design in Copenhagen
Palazzo and cathedral engineering perspectives across historic Italian ports
Contemporary sustainable urban design showcases in Oslo and Helsinki

items.title: 2. Culinary Discovery Tours – Chef-Led Gastronomy
paragraphs: Culinary Discovery Tours are Oceania's flagship food experiences, led directly by chef instructors from The Culinary Center.

Guests tour bustling neighborhood markets, sample artisanal produce, meet local cheesemakers and vintners, and often return to the ship for a private hands-on cooking class incorporating market ingredients.
Best for: Serious food lovers, home cooks, and travelers wanting authentic gastronomic immersion.

lists.title: Culinary Discovery Experiences
items: Shopping historic fish and vegetable markets in Marseille, Athens, or Palermo with an executive chef
Private olive oil tastings and pasta workshops in Tuscan farm estates
Seafood foraging and Michelin-starred tasting luncheons in Northern Spain
Exclusive availability aboard Marina, Riviera, Vista, and Allura

items.title: 3. Executive Collection – Private Car, Driver & Guide
paragraphs: The Executive Collection provides the ultimate in private, customizable shore exploration with a private luxury vehicle, driver, and English-speaking guide.
You retain total control over your schedule, stops, and pace—allowing you to linger at favorite sights or bypass crowded attractions entirely.
Best for: Couples, multi-generational families, or small private groups desiring total schedule autonomy.

lists.title: Executive Collection Advantages
items: Completely customized itineraries tailored to your exact personal interests
Door-to-door port pickup and drop-off in a luxury sedan or private minivan
Total flexibility to adjust tour timing on the fly based on weather or energy levels
Available in most major worldwide ports subject to advance reservation

items.title: 4. Oceania Exclusive Excursions – Small Groups (Max 16)
paragraphs: Oceania Exclusive excursions follow signature guided itineraries but strictly limit party size to a maximum of 16 participants.
Smaller group sizes ensure agile transport, priority entry, intimate interactions with local guides, and zero waiting on large coach groups.
Best for: Travelers who appreciate guided structure but dislike large tour buses and crowded groups.

lists.title: Small-Group Excursion Benefits
items: Capped at exactly 16 guests per group for an intimate, boutique feel
Enhanced two-way dialogue and Q&A with specialist local historians
Faster embarking and disembarking at popular archaeological and museum sites
Use of nimble executive mini-coaches rather than 50-passenger buses

items.title: 5. Go Local Tours – Everyday Life & Community Encounters
paragraphs: Go Local tours bypass typical tourist routes to immerse guests in everyday community life, local traditions, and neighborhood customs.
Guests visit family-run bakeries, community markets, craft workshops, and private homes to converse with residents and understand regional lifestyles.
Best for: Curious travelers who value authentic cultural connections over conventional tourist monuments.

lists.title: Go Local Sample Encounters
items: Playing pétanque with village locals in a small French Riviera square
Visiting traditional textile and ceramic artisans in Greek island mountain villages
Joining a local family for home-cooked afternoon tea and pastry baking in Ireland
Exploring residential neighborhood food stalls with local neighborhood residents

items.title: 6. Food & Wine Trails Tours – Terroir & Viticulture
paragraphs: Food & Wine Trails excursions explore regional viticultural heritage, historic wine estates, and gourmet farm-to-table pairings.
Led by certified sommeliers, culinary experts, or estate winemakers, these tours celebrate the connection between soil, climate, and taste.
Best for: Wine connoisseurs, vineyard enthusiasts, and travelers passionate about European and New World wine culture.

lists.title: Food & Wine Trails Highlights
items: Cellar tours and private tastings at premier cru estates in Bordeaux and Burgundy
Super Tuscan vineyard visits and olive grove luncheons in Bolgheri and Chianti
Rioja and Ribera del Duero bodega tastings paired with regional tapas in Spain
Sommelier-guided port tastings in historic Vila Nova de Gaia cellars

items.title: 7. Wellness Discovery Tours by Aquamar – Mindful Travel
paragraphs: Curated in partnership with Oceania's Aquamar Spa + Vitality Center, these tours focus on traditional wellness, restorative nature, and mindfulness.
Experiences range from thermal hot spring bathing and yoga in scenic coastal settings to learning ancient herbal medicine remedies.
Best for: Wellness seekers, nature lovers, and travelers wanting peaceful rejuvenation ashore.

lists.title: Wellness Discovery Experiences
items: Therapeutic mineral baths and mud treatments in natural Mediterranean thermal springs
Guided meditation and yoga on secluded rocky coves in the Greek Isles
Forest bathing and botanical herbal medicine walks in Scandinavian woodlands
Centuries-old tea ceremony rituals and restorative wellness traditions in East Asia

items.title: 8. Go Green Tours – Conservation & Sustainability
paragraphs: Go Green tours highlight ecological conservation, renewable energy initiatives, wildlife preservation, and sustainable agriculture.
Guests witness how local communities and innovative researchers work to protect vulnerable ecosystems and preserve indigenous heritage.
Best for: Eco-conscious travelers interested in biodiversity, conservation science, and responsible tourism.

lists.title: Go Green Sustainable Projects
items: Visiting organic solar-powered vineyards and bio-dynamic farms in the Mediterranean
Marine biology encounters and coral reef restoration projects in the Caribbean and South Pacific
Reforestation and wildlife rehabilitation center visits in Costa Rica and Norway
Learning how historic coastal towns implement modern climate-resilience measures

items.title: 9. Evening Excursions – Nightlife & Sunset Sights
paragraphs: Capitalizing on Oceania's late-night port departures and overnight stays, Evening Excursions reveal a destination's nocturnal charm.
From sunset catamaran cruises and classical concerts in historic palaces to tapas crawls and night markets, experience ports when day-trippers have left.
Best for: Night owls, romantic couples, and travelers wanting extended cultural immersion.

lists.title: Evening Port Highlights
items: Chamber music concerts in historic baroque palaces in Vienna or St. Petersburg
Sunset sailboat cruises along the dramatic caldera cliffs of Santorini
Private evening dining and flamenco performances in Seville or Barcelona
Night market culinary walks and neon illuminated harbor tours in Singapore and Tokyo

items.title: 10. Oceania Select Excursions – Standout Icons
paragraphs: Oceania Select excursions highlight the most iconic, awe-inspiring, and culturally momentous experiences in each global region.
These curated tours frequently include exclusive access, private transport, and expert guest lecturers for unforgettable bucket-list sightseeing.
Best for: First-time visitors seeking the definitive, can't-miss highlights of a landmark destination.

lists.title: Oceania Select Landmark Experiences
items: Exclusive early-access guided walkthrough of the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
Charter flight or private express rail to the Taj Mahal or Luxor's Valley of the Kings
Helicopter flightseeing over Alaskan glaciers and Hawaiian volcanic craters
Private after-hours tours of the Hermitage or Topkapi Palace

activityAndMobility.title: Activity Ratings & Older Traveler Accessibility
activityAndMobility.subtitle: CRITICAL CONSIDERATIONS BEFORE SELECTING YOUR TOURS

cards.title: Oceania Excursion Activity Levels Explained
items: Level 1 (Mild): Involves leisurely walking over relatively even surfaces, with minimal stairs and extended seated transport.
Level 2 (Moderate): Involves moderate walking (1–2 miles) over cobblestones, uneven terrain, and several flights of stairs.
Level 3 (Strenuous): Involves strenuous hiking, uphill climbs, rugged terrain, steep stairs, or prolonged exposure to heat/sun.
Always review the tour's specific physical requirements—a Level 1 tour may still require stepping in and out of high tour buses.
Historic Mediterranean and European city centers feature uneven cobblestones and limited vehicular access.

cards.title: Mobility & Older Traveler Comfort Considerations
items: Collapsible wheelchairs can generally be stored beneath tour motorcoaches if guests can independently navigate bus entry steps.
Tender ports (where small boats transport guests ashore) may restrict wheelchair embarkation depending on sea conditions.
The Executive Collection provides the safest, most comfortable alternative for guests with limited stamina or mobility challenges.
Guests should notify Oceania's Shore Excursion desk upon booking to confirm accessibility arrangements for specific ports.
Schedule relaxed sea days or independent port mornings between intense tour days to prevent vacation fatigue.

bookingSteps.title: How to Book Oceania Shore Excursions & Apply Credits
bookingSteps.subtitle: A PRACTICAL 4-PHASE GUIDE FROM SELECTION TO DISEMBARKATION

steps.title: Phase 1: Confirm Your Excursion Credit
steps.description: Ensure your booking has selected Shore Excursion Credit ($400–$1,200) instead of Complimentary Wine and Beer prior to your final payment deadline.

steps.title: Phase 2: Research Port Options 120+ Days Out
steps.description: Log into your Oceania My Account portal to explore available tours across each port on your itinerary, comparing duration, activity rating, and group size.

steps.title: Phase 3: Reserve Online at Least 14 Days Prior
steps.description: Secure your preferred tours early. Published terms recommend selecting credit-funded tours at least 14 days before departure to guarantee credit application and avoid sold-out small-group excursions.

steps.title: Phase 4: Confirm Tickets Onboard on Day One
steps.description: Upon embarkation, your excursion tickets will be waiting in your stateroom. Review meeting times and locations; stop by Destination Services if any itinerary adjustments are needed.

expertTips.title: Expert Tips for Getting the Most From Oceania Shore Excursions
expertTips.subtitle: INSIDER STRATEGIES FROM CERTIFIED CRUISE ADVISORS

items.title: Book Small Groups Early
items.description: Oceania Exclusive (max 16) and Culinary Discovery Tours fill up fast. Reserve them the moment your booking opens online.

items.title: Prioritize Denser, Complex Ports
items.description: Use your tour credit for ports where sights are far from the pier (like Florence from Livorno, or Rome from Civitavecchia).

items.title: Explore Walkable Towns on Foot
items.description: Save excursion funds in ports where the ship docks directly in town (like Dubrovnik, Kotor, or San Juan) and explore on your own.

items.title: Verify Cobblestone & Stair Counts
items.description: Check tour descriptions carefully. European medieval towns involve significant cobblestone walking and ancient staircases.

items.title: Utilize Unused Credit on Board
items.description: If you don't spend all your excursion credit ashore, current published terms allow remaining balances to convert to shipboard credit.

items.title: Share an Executive Collection Car
items.description: A private van and driver split between two couples often costs less per person than two separate high-end group tours.

items.title: Leverage Evening Port Stays
items.description: Take advantage of late-night departures by booking an evening tapas crawl or sunset catamaran cruise after daytime crowds depart.

items.title: Carry Cash for Guide Gratuities
items.description: Local guide and driver tips are customary ($5–$10 per person) and must be paid in local currency, not billed to your cruise folio.

items.title: Dress Appropriately for Sacred Sites
items.description: Cathedrals and mosques in Italy, Greece, and Turkey strictly enforce covered shoulders and knees. Pack a light scarf or shawl.

items.title: Mind the 14-Day Booking Rule
items.description: Ensure your credit-funded excursions are finalized online at least 14 days prior to embarkation under published guidelines.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Oceania Shore Excursions
faqs.subtitle: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT CREDITS, BOOKING & TOUR TYPES

questions.question: Are shore excursions included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Not all shore excursions are automatically included in the cruise fare. Eligible bookings can choose a shore excursion credit as one of the Your World Included amenities, which can be applied toward qualifying excursions under booking terms.

questions.question: How much shore excursion credit does Oceania Cruises offer?
questions.answer: The current published credit ranges from $400 to $1,200 depending on voyage length: up to 9 days receives $400; 10–13 days receives $600; 14–19 days receives $800; 20–25 days receives $1,000; and 26 days or longer receives $1,200 per stateroom.

questions.question: Is Oceania's shore excursion credit per person or per stateroom?
questions.answer: It is generally per stateroom. Published terms provide an exception for qualifying solo travelers booked in a Solo category or with a single-supplement discount, where the credit is calculated per guest.

questions.question: Can I choose shore excursion credit instead of complimentary wine and beer?
questions.answer: Yes. Eligible bookings can choose one of the two amenities: Shore Excursion Credit or Complimentary Wine and Beer. They are alternatives rather than cumulative benefits.

questions.question: Can I use Oceania shore excursion credit for any tour?
questions.answer: The credit is subject to Oceania's booking terms and excursion eligibility. Review the available tours and applicable conditions in your My Account portal before making reservations.

questions.question: What happens if I do not use all my shore excursion credit?
questions.answer: Under current published terms, unused credit can be used as shipboard credit on the same voyage. Any amount not used by disembarkation is surrendered.

questions.question: When should I book Oceania shore excursions?
questions.answer: Book early where possible, particularly for limited-capacity tours. Guests selecting the current shore excursion credit are advised to secure their excursions at least 14 days before sailing.

questions.question: Can I book Oceania shore excursions after boarding?
questions.answer: Availability may remain after boarding at the Destination Services desk, but popular excursions can sell out. It is strongly recommended to reserve preferred experiences before departure.

questions.question: Does Oceania offer private shore excursions?
questions.answer: Yes. The Executive Collection provides private driver and English-speaking guide arrangements in selected ports, subject to availability.

questions.question: What are Oceania Exclusive excursions?
questions.answer: Oceania Exclusive excursions are small-group experiences strictly capped at a maximum of 16 guests. They are designed to offer a more intimate tour and greater personal attention.

questions.question: What are Oceania Go Local tours?
questions.answer: Go Local tours focus on everyday life in a destination. They may include visits to local homes, neighborhood businesses, community markets, craftspeople and authentic cultural experiences.

questions.question: What are Culinary Discovery Tours?
questions.answer: Culinary Discovery Tours focus on local food culture led by chef instructors from The Culinary Center. Guests visit food markets, meet producers, taste regional dishes, and participate in hands-on cooking classes.

questions.question: What are Beyond Blueprints tours?
questions.answer: Beyond Blueprints tours focus on architecture and design, offering behind-the-scenes access and commentary on significant historic and contemporary buildings.

questions.question: Does Oceania offer food and wine excursions?
questions.answer: Yes. Food & Wine Trails tours explore regional cuisine and wine traditions, featuring winery visits, sommelier tastings, and estate luncheons in premier wine regions.

questions.question: Are Oceania shore excursions suitable for older travelers?
questions.answer: Some excursions are suitable for guests who prefer a relaxed pace, but activity levels vary. Review walking distances, stairs, cobblestones, and physical requirements before booking.

questions.question: Can I arrange my own private tour instead of booking through Oceania?
questions.answer: Yes. Guests can arrange independent tours and transportation, but must carefully manage return timing. Independent excursions do not qualify for Oceania's shore excursion credit and the ship will not wait if you are delayed.

questions.question: Are Oceania shore excursions refundable?
questions.answer: Cancellation terms vary by excursion. The cruise line's general terms state that optional services, including shore excursions, are generally non-refundable except where expressly provided in the applicable contract or tour conditions.

questions.question: Do Oceania shore excursions include meals?
questions.answer: Some excursions include meals, tastings or refreshments, while others do not. Check the individual tour description to confirm what is covered.

questions.question: Do Oceania shore excursions include transportation?
questions.answer: Organized excursions generally specify the transportation included in the tour description (air-conditioned motorcoaches, executive minivans, or boats).

questions.question: Are Oceania shore excursions worth the cost?
questions.answer: They are worthwhile when the tour offers knowledgeable guides, convenient transportation, special access or a distinctive cultural experience. Compare the price with what you would spend arranging the same experience independently.
